The console engine's runtime gate is one engine cycle, which also reads that no `run/workspace-key` is written. The webview gates run (this chunk writes under `pulse-app/ui/**`), and so do `cargo deny` and `cargo audit` (the manifests and the lockfile change). This chunk changes the procedure set, so the bindings close is the procedure-changing form: regen after the workspace run, two content probes, the bindings staged with the pin, `check:staged-artifacts`, then `capability-drift` last; the regen runs before the `ui/dist` and release builds. With the feature gone the default build is the full shape, so the regen carries no feature. Lean checks per `inputs#I1`: the gates this plan requires, each run once; no repeat loop. No headful self-verify is listed: `cargo xtask self-verify` drives WebView2 through `msedgedriver` on a Windows host, and this Linux host has none; the window smoke and the a11y suite stand in for the UI half.

`cargo xtask test:a11y` is not a local entry: at P5 it read red on the untouched tree for a host reason (`browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist at ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1217/…`, the Playwright headless shell is not installed on this host). Lean checks per `inputs#I1`: no browser is installed for it; the CI `a11y` job runs the same command (`cargo xtask test:a11y`, with its regression detector and its two uploads) and is read by name in the CI read. Locally the suite's config-named `--list` entry stands guard against a list-time import failure.

`cargo audit` read red at P5 on the untouched tree: 42 vulnerabilities (62 distinct ids with the allowed warnings), advisories dated up to 2026-10-29 against crates this chunk does not touch (wasmtime 48.0.5, rustls 0.23.45, quinn-proto 0.11.15, rustls-webpki, webpki-roots, webpki-root-certs, the zstd family, zip 4.6.1, pulldown-cmark 0.13.3, tokio 1.52.1, zbus_names, zvariant, event-listener). It is external decay (playbook, External decay: routine), and on the operator's P5 answer (`inputs#I3`, the overseer as the founder's delegate, PROVISIONAL) this chunk goes on as a removal: the `cargo audit` entry and the CI read are report-only, the report carries the id set, and the wrap mints the owner entry «Advisories since 2026-10-12 closed» directly after this one. No finding is ignore-listed (`rules/security.md`: a finding with a stated safe upgrade is never ignore-listed). The CI verdict therefore reads green on every check but `supply-chain`, whose red is that owned decay.
